item.title: Billboard Hot Latin Songs Top 10 Countdown for August 8th, 2026 | Billboard Latin
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest update on the Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart. Let's dive into the top 10 for the week of August 8th.
[Short music transition]
Host: Bad Bunny is still killing the game, with several tracks from his album 'Debí Tirar Más Fotos' dominating the chart. But Karol G is giving him a run for his money with her new song "Matadora", which debuts at number 3.
[Short music transition]
Host: Here's a quick rundown of the top 10: Calle 24 and Fuerza Regida are at number 10, followed by "Todo Lo Fue" at 9, El de Las R's at 8, "De Lejitos" at 7, "Koko" at 6, "Voy A Llevarte Pa PR" at 5, and "Ayúdame" at 4.
[Short music transition]
Host: Rounding out the top 3, we have Karol G's "Matadora" at 3, "Nuevayol" at 2, and Bad Bunny's "DTMF" holding strong at number 1 for an impressive 71st week.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for this week's update. If you want to stay up-to-date on the latest Latin music news, be sure to subscribe and hit the notification bell. Thanks for tuning in!
